author: ETA PRIME
description:
Out of the box, the GMKtec Neo X1 ships with an NVIDIA RTX 5070 and Windows 11—and it’s already a great compact gaming machine. But I wanted to turn this 14.6L liquid-cooled system into a proper, all-AMD SteamOS powerhouse. 

Buy the GMKTec X1 Neo Pro Here: https://tidd.ly/4d1t3i3
Or Buy it on Amazon: https://link.amazon/B0aO6hEzD
Buy A Radeon 9070 XT Here: https://link.amazon/B0dWXHEnU

In this video, we pull out the factory RTX 5070, swap in the ASRock Monster Hunter Wilds Edition AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (16GB VRAM) using a 12VHPWR to dual 8-pin adapter, and install official stock SteamOS 3.9.5 (Holo) on a secondary SSD for a clean dual-boot setup. Paired with the liquid-cooled 16-core/32-thread AMD Ryzen 9 9955HX3D and 64GB of DDR5 SODIMM RAM, this compact SFF rig absolutely screams at 1440p Ultra and handles 4K gaming with Proton GE and FSR 4.1!
